legal_gdpr_transfer_mechanism: Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) + EU data residency (Frankfurt) — Zoho includes DPA with Frankfurt pinning; HubSpot requires add-on DPA exhibit

legal_risks.risk: Subprocessor change without adequate notice — 30-day notice clause is contractually required but enforcement depends on DPA exhibit listing current subprocessors at signing
legal_risks.mitigation: Require DPA exhibit listing all subprocessors; include right to object with 30-day cure period before change takes effect

legal_risks.risk: Data subject rights (DSARs) under GDPR Art 15-22 — vendor processing agreement must explicitly allocate processor obligations; Zoho standard DPA covers this but must be verified for logistics-sector special categories
legal_risks.mitigation: Confirm DPA includes Art 28 processor obligations, DSAR assistance clause, and breach notification within 72h; obtain written confirmation before contract execution

legal_risks.risk: Auto-renewal without legal review — contract auto-renewal may carry forward terms that were acceptable at signing but become non-compliant with updated GDPR guidance or Schrems-III developments
legal_risks.mitigation: Assign a contract owner with a 90-day advance review trigger; re-validate SCCs against current regulatory status at each renewal

legal_risks.risk: Third-party NetSuite connector is outside Zoho DPA scope — data flows through connector vendor are not covered by Zoho's liability cap or GDPR processor obligations
legal_risks.mitigation: Obtain a separate DPA and liability agreement from the NetSuite connector vendor; ensure data minimisation — only CRM-relevant fields pass through the connector

legal_risks.risk: Post-termination data deletion — GDPR Art 17 requires timely erasure; 30-day export window is adequate but deletion confirmation from vendor is not currently specified
legal_risks.mitigation: Add a deletion certificate obligation to the DPA: vendor must confirm irreversible deletion within 60 days of contract end
